notes.title: Changing price to free in early May 2023
notes.notes:
I first off want to thank my family, friends, and those I have never met for purchasing Loopback and supporting me on my first attempt to make and release a game! Your support is greatly appreciated!

My intent was always to create a game that people would enjoy playing and I hope this change will provide an opportunity for a wider audience to check it out. Thanks everyone!
